name: GPU Raycasting for Stack-Based Terrains
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering of Stack-Based Terrains
definition: A volume rendering method adapted for Stack-Based Terrains (SBRT) that casts rays from a virtual camera through each output buffer pixel, composing sampled colors along the ray path.
summary: GPU Raycasting for Stack-Based Terrains is a direct volume rendering technique that visualizes geoscientific data using a hybrid deferred normal calculation strategy to avoid performance bottlenecks.
